researchLog.note: Round 4: FamilySearch supplies birth 12 Nov 1741 Shutesbury and death 8 Dec 1831 Albany; link to Johnny still unproven.

bio: FamilySearch (profile 'Sarah Scott') gives her birth at Shutesbury, Mass., on 12 Nov 1741 from a Massachusetts births index entry for Sarah Chamberlain, and her death on 8 Dec 1831 at Albany, NY, with a Find a Grave index entry as 'Sarah Chamberlain Scott'; a Vermont vital record for her son Jonathan Scott names her ([R4-S1]). As with her husband Matthew, her place in Johnny's ancestry depends on the undocumented Daniel Scott link.
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Sarah Scott (GF8N-M3N), citing Massachusetts Births and Christenings (ark 1:1:FC3J-3HY), Find a Grave index (1:1:QV2Y-KVQJ), Vermont Vital Records (1:1:V8MB-MFD) (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/GF8N-M3N
